name: search_products
description: Handles broad, open-ended natural language queries. Performs a semantic (BM25) search on key product information (brand, color, size, material, season, demographics, and name) and returns an initial set of relevant product_ids.

query.description: Natural language query, e.g. 'Nike running shoes' or 'orange Uniqlo T-shirt'.

limit.description: Maximum number of product_ids to return (default 20).

name: filter_by_brand
description: Filters a list of product_ids by one or more brand names (case-insensitive, OR logic). If product_ids is omitted, filters from the entire per-case catalog.

product_ids.description: Optional candidate product_ids. Defaults to the full catalog.

name: filter_by_color
description: Filters a list of product_ids by one or more colors (case-insensitive, OR logic). If product_ids is omitted, filters from the entire per-case catalog.

product_ids.description: Optional candidate product_ids. Defaults to the full catalog.

name: filter_by_size
description: Filters a list of product_ids by one or more sizes (case-insensitive, OR logic). If product_ids is omitted, filters from the entire per-case catalog.

product_ids.description: Optional candidate product_ids. Defaults to the full catalog.

name: filter_by_range
description: Filters a list of product_ids by a numerical feature, a comparison operator, and a threshold value. condition_key can address a nested field with dot notation (e.g. 'rating.average_score'). If product_ids is omitted, filters from the entire per-case catalog.

name: filter_by_applicable_coupons
description: Filters product_ids by applicable coupons. Returns products whose `applicable_coupons` is a superset of the requested coupon_names. If product_ids is omitted, filters from the entire per-case catalog.

coupon_names.description: Coupon names; products must have ALL of them applicable.

name: sort_products
description: Sorts a list of product_ids by a specified dimension. If product_ids is omitted, sorts the entire per-case catalog.

name: get_product_details
description: Returns the full product record for each of the given product_ids. Missing ids are silently skipped.

name: calculate_transport_time
description: Estimates delivery days for a product from its shipping origin to a destination province. Returns an integer day count, never less than 1.

provider.description: Optional. Override the product's default shipping provider. Supported: 'sf_express', 'jd_logistics', 'yto_express', 'zto_express', 'sto_express', 'yunda_express', 'cainiao', 'china_post', 'ems', 'deppon_express', 'default'.

name: get_user_info
description: Returns the per-case user record (user_id, address, body profile, owned coupons, vip status, etc.). The user_id argument is optional; if provided and matches the user_id stored in the per-case record, returns it. Otherwise returns the case's default user.

user_id.description: Optional. The unique identifier of the user to retrieve.

name: add_product_to_cart
description: Adds a product to the cart. Validates product existence and stock availability. If the product is already in the cart, increases its quantity. Returns the updated cart.

product_id.description: Product id (must exist in the per-case catalog).

name: delete_product_from_cart
description: Removes a product from the cart or reduces its quantity. If the quantity to remove equals or exceeds the cart quantity, the item is fully removed. Returns the updated cart.

product_id.description: Product id (must exist and currently be in the cart).

name: get_cart_info
description: Returns the current shopping cart: items (each with product_id, name, quantity, price), used_coupons, and a summary object with total_items_count and total_price.

name: add_coupon_to_cart
description: Adds a coupon to the cart. Validates: coupon name is recognized; user owns enough copies of it; VIP coupons require VIP status; the combined threshold across all used coupons is met by the cart total. Returns the updated cart with `used_coupons` and a post-discount `summary.total_price`.

coupon_name.description: Coupon name. Examples: 'Cross-store: ¥30 off every ¥300', 'Same-brand: ¥25 off every ¥200', 'VIP: ¥200 off every ¥1,000'.

name: delete_coupon_from_cart
description: Removes a coupon from the cart or reduces its quantity. If the quantity to remove equals or exceeds the current cart quantity, the coupon is fully removed. Returns the updated cart with recomputed `summary.total_price`.

coupon_name.description: Coupon name (must currently be in the cart).
